class arbdmodel.interactions.BoundaryPotential(cell_vectors, cell_origin=None, well_depth=1.0, resolution=2.0, blur=5.0, filename='boundary.dx', **kwargs)[source]#

Bases: AbstractPotential

Boundary potential for confining simulations.

__init__(cell_vectors, cell_origin=None, well_depth=1.0, resolution=2.0, blur=5.0, filename='boundary.dx', **kwargs)[source]#

Initialize boundary potential.

Parameters:

  • cell_vectors – List of 3 cell basis vectors [[x1,y1,z1], [x2,y2,z2], [x3,y3,z3]]

  • cell_origin – Cell origin coordinates [x,y,z]

  • well_depth – Depth of potential well

  • resolution – Grid resolution

  • blur – Smoothing parameter

  • **kwargs – Additional parameters for AbstractPotential

potential(r, types=None)[source]#

Calculate potential at positions.

This isn’t used directly for grid potentials in ARBD, but implemented for consistency with the AbstractPotential interface.

write_file(filename=None, types=None)[source]#

Write boundary potential to grid file.
